standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, the lemma that a local ring of dimension zero with separably algebraically closed residue field is strictly henselian, together with Same chapter, the comparison of etale and Zariski cohomology for schemes with strictly henselian local rings

core_obligations: Profinite topology (proof lines 14289-14293): condition (1) makes the underlying space of S profinite by the algebra lemma, so the higher cohomology of an abelian sheaf on the topological space vanishes.
Strictly henselian local rings (proof lines 14294-14296): the local rings are strictly henselian by the dimension-zero algebra lemma, so etale cohomology of S is computed by Zariski cohomology.
Conclude (proof lines 14297-14300): combining the two statements gives H^i(S_etale, F) = 0 for i > 0.
proof_roadmap: Identify the underlying space as profinite and use the vanishing on such spaces.
Identify the local rings as strictly henselian and compare etale with Zariski cohomology.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the vanishing of the higher etale cohomology on an affine scheme all of whose points are closed with separably algebraically closed residue fields (statement lines 14279-14286). The proof (proof lines 14288-14300) identifies the underlying space as profinite, whence the Zariski cohomology vanishes, and identifies the local rings as strictly henselian, whence etale and Zariski cohomology agree. H2: two identifications plus the comparison.
